page.overview:
Who is Celestin Eguilera?

Celestin is about 5'6" tall. She has black and straight hair worn above the shoulder at a length that suggested she can’t decide whether to wear it long or short. Her eyes are gray, though they seem almost pale blue at times. Her nose is perhaps a little too prominent; it makes her look like she's looking down on people, which she probably is, consistent with her somewhat supercilious manner.

Celestin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She went to the White Tower in 976 NE at the age of sixteen.
